title: Hide-Kin Tunnels
changes: When the Hide-Kin strike a land two borders away, their tunnel now breaks out at that land's edge. Come near and its mouth opens, with Hide-Kin soldiers pouring out in waves.
Heroes sworn against the Hide-Kin can collapse the tunnel for valor and renown. It stays shut until the next war turn.
Hide-Kin heroes who guard their tunnel earn valor for their clan in that land.
